name: Template Generator
project_description:
This module allows you to automatically generate your templates for your content entities.

 - Ability to select the entities to generate

- Possibility to automatically sort the templates by view mode or by bundle

- Ability to ignore certain view modes or bundles

- Automatic addition of the variables available in the header comment.

- The possibility of automatically generating the templates after each change of display settings

 By default the files will be exported: your-current-theme/templates

It is possible to change themes in the configurations.

 Sponsors 
 The Template Generator module was sponsored by GAYA.
